sections.heading: Lodging
sections.text: Lodging at on-site business meetings shall be reimbursed at actual cost up to the GSA per-diem rate for the locality.

sections.heading: Meal Allowance
sections.text: Per-diem meal allowance for on-site business meetings shall not exceed $75.00 per traveler per calendar day, inclusive of gratuity.

sections.heading: Incidental Expenses
sections.text: Incidental expenses (parking, tolls, business calls) shall be reimbursed at actual cost with itemized receipts.

sections.heading: Approval Threshold
sections.text: All overtime hours in excess of 16 per pay period require Manager approval prior to work performance.

sections.heading: Fatigue Management
sections.text: Cumulative work hours shall conform to 10 CFR 26 fatigue-management limits; covered employees may not exceed 16 hours in any 24-hour period without supervisor sign-off.

sections.heading: Accrual
sections.text: Full-time employees accrue PTO at 1.92 hours per pay period during the first 5 years, 2.77 thereafter, capped at 200 hours.

sections.heading: Eligibility
sections.text: STP will reimburse pre-approved external training up to $5,000/year for active full-time employees with at least 12 months of service.

sections.heading: Issue & Wear
sections.text: All personnel inside the protected area shall display a site-issued photo ID badge above the waist at all times. Lost badges must be reported within 30 minutes.

sections.heading: Escort Requirements
sections.text: All vendors lacking unescorted-access training shall be continuously escorted by an STP employee in the protected area; escort ratios shall not exceed 1:5.

sections.heading: Vibration Monitoring
sections.text: Reactor coolant pump vibration shall be monitored continuously; any single-axis reading exceeding 0.30 in/s peak shall trigger a Tech-Spec entry within 4 hours.

sections.heading: Lockout / Tagout
sections.text: Prior to maintenance on any RCP, two-person verification of breaker open and tag-applied shall be documented in the work package per OSHA 1910.147.

sections.heading: Limiting Condition for Operation
sections.text: Two of three Essential Service Water pumps shall be operable in MODES 1, 2, 3, 4. With one pump inoperable, restore within 7 days or be in MODE 3 within the next 6 hours and MODE 5 within the following 36 hours.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.text: This procedure governs scheduled inspection of RCP thrust and journal bearings on Westinghouse Model-93A RCPs at intervals of 730 days.

sections.heading: Acceptance Criteria
sections.text: Bearing axial vibration shall be ≤ 0.20 in/s post-maintenance; thrust play shall be 0.020 ± 0.005 in.
